receipts.title: Unreadable photo, 400 px
receipts.expect: Stopped at the quality gate (R-QUA-1) with the measured size and a fix; never sent to the model; not matched; out of totals.

receipts.title: Heavy blur at full size
receipts.stress: an unreadable photo (heavy blur), at a size that passes the gate
receipts.expect: Either read correctly, or every doubtful field is flagged (LOW_CONFIDENCE_FIELD or UNREADABLE). Never a wrong total, date, or currency with high confidence that a person could bulk-approve.

receipts.title: Chat screenshot
receipts.stress: a non-receipt image (a screenshot of a chat)
receipts.expect: NOT_A_RECEIPT (R-QUA-4), in the first queue group; it must not take the $45.00 Sample Supplies line, which stays listed as a line with no receipt.

receipts.title: Bare $ with no currency clues
receipts.businessPurpose: Afternoon tea with a new hire
receipts.expect: Currency flagged for a person (R-CUR-5: never assumed to be AUD without evidence), so it is not bulk-approvable. No address, ABN, GST, or currency code is printed.

receipts.title: Ambiguous numeric date from a US vendor
receipts.expect: The printed 10/09/2026 is month-first (a US invoice: 9 October). Read as 2026-10-09, or the date flagged low-confidence. Never 2026-09-10 with high confidence.

receipts.title: One receipt, two payments
receipts.stress: a receipt covering two items paid in two transactions
receipts.businessPurpose: Accommodation and room hire for the regional sales visit
receipts.expect: Never auto-paired with either part payment (each is far from $620). It goes to a person, and both lines stay visible, so the $620 is not lost or counted twice.

receipts.title: Purchase later refunded
receipts.businessPurpose: Tools to mount the meeting-room screen
receipts.expect: Matched to the $64.00 purchase. The −$64.00 refund three days later is never offered as a payment for any receipt; it is listed as a credit for a person to record.

receipts.title: Only the refund is on the statement
receipts.stress: a refund (a negative statement line), with no purchase line
receipts.expect: The purchase is not on this statement, only a −$38.50 refund two days later. NO_PAYMENT_FOUND; the refund is never offered as the payment (choosing it would put a negative amount in the ledger as if paid).
